name: Alone at the Pool
source:
Toby, a young urban explorer, decides to visit an abandoned swimming pool on the outskirts of the city. There, he meets an unusually tall girl, who visited the pool in search for a lonely place. As the two of them get to know each other, Toby will quickly learn that the girl is more troubled that she seems to be.

This is a simple tale of two people - a birth of a strong bond between two lonely souls.

...Yep. That's it.

[From [url=https://hidden-raisin.itch.io/aloneatthepool]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
托比是一位年轻的城市探险家，他决定参观市郊的一个废弃游泳池。在那里，他遇到了一个异常高大的女孩，她来到游泳池寻找一个孤独的地方。随着两人逐渐了解，托比很快就会发现这个女孩比她看上去的更烦恼。

这是一个关于两个人的简单故事——两个孤独的灵魂之间牢固的纽带的诞生。

…是的。就是这样。

[来自[url=https://hidden-raisin.itch.io/aloneatthepool]itch.io[/url]]
